tools.name: check_stat
tools.description: Paste a marketing or influencer-marketing statistic (a sentence or a whole paragraph), or ask for a reference number (e.g. 'what share of US adults use TikTok'). Returns the best-matching checked claim with its verdict, confidence, primary source, what the source actually says, a safe rephrasing and

tools.name: verify_text
tools.description: Paste a whole draft (up to 20,000 characters: a blog post, deck notes, an email, a social caption). Splits it into sentences, keeps each sentence that contains a number or statistic, and matches each one against the checked claims. Returns one row per statement with the numbers found, the match leve

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Keyword search over all checked marketing statistics (claim text, common phrasing, origin publisher). Optionally filter by verdict. Returns short summaries; get_claim returns the full record for an id.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Full record for one checked claim by id (slug) or claim page URL: verdict, confidence, origin, exact quote, method and sample, drift, publisher interest, safe rephrasing and every source we opened.

tools.name: list_verdicts
tools.description: The four verdicts (verified, misquoted, outdated, unsourced) with definitions and how many claims carry each, plus confidence levels and dataset info.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_stat, verify_text, get_claim · Private data: check_stat, search_claims, get_claim · Public sink: check_stat, verify_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_stat, verify_text, get_claim · Private data: check_stat, search_claims, get_claim · Public sink: check_stat, verify_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
